p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, start-up, investment platforms: official resources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, opens the latest official sources, then read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: World Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): duties, taxes, rules and procedures for specific products and countries on one hand
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (STO): standards, labelling and health rules for products in this country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade to and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: customs code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): business start-up, taxes, international trade, by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): Before you entrust your money to a platform, check if the regulator has marked the platform as illegal.
p.espaces.rg_note: The website opens in your language: use the browser translator or "Understanding the document" for the document.Consult an expert in this country for an important decision.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: A guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market access map (ITC, UN-WTO): duties and rules for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French Customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Bill of Lading (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duty)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (EU importing or exporting companies)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles all from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods, cleared for export, to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; after that, risks and costs pass to the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines.Such lists are rejected and can be reported (en).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before you send.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD itself does not send money and does not earn anything with these links: here you compare, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Transfer prices worldwide (World Bank): actual costs of sending money, by country, by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Receive cash, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, charges shown before shipment
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: See the total amount received: fees + exchange rate, which is worse than the market rate, is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person will receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN …).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An identity document is often required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online or to “unlock” a prize, package, loan or visa: this is almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: find a supplier, calculate the right price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer. Getting started is easy, but you remain responsible for the sales.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorised in your customers’ country: no counterfeits and unauthorised regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (Wholesale/supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, delivery, customs duties, VAT in the buyer's country, payment and return costs.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade Rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants the full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
